questions.question: What is a domain intelligence platform?
options: Shared capabilities — knowledge, system connections, reasoning, and quality controls — used by many AI applications in a domain
A single chatbot for one team
questions.explanation: It's shared infrastructure, so each new application builds on the same foundation.

questions.question: In the knowledge layer, what do documents and a domain model each capture?
options: Neither is needed if you have a large model
Documents capture structure; the domain model captures reasoning
Documents capture reasoning; the domain model captures structure
questions.explanation: Memos explain why; a graph of entities and relationships captures what connects to what.

questions.question: If a system of record produces the authoritative answer, the AI should…
options: Call the system rather than guess
Ask the user to calculate it
Estimate the answer to save time
questions.explanation: Route authoritative answers to systems of record through tools.

questions.question: Who must help define what a 'correct' answer is in a specialized domain?
questions.explanation: Experts build and review the evaluation set; engineers can't define correctness alone.
